items.title: Wim Hof Method: More Intense Than Black Coffee
items.description: A modern recreation of ancient Tummo meditation. Heavy hyperventilation induces a micro-adrenaline release, completely sweeping away morning grogginess.

items.question: Are these high-intensity methods safe?
items.answer: As long as practiced in a safe environment (sitting on a couch or lying in bed), they are perfectly safe for healthy individuals. NEVER practice while driving or in water.

items.question: Why do my hands and feet tingle after practice?
items.answer: Expelling massive amounts of CO2 temporarily alters blood pH and constricts blood vessels. This tingling (T-rex hands) is the standard physiological response of energy charging and means your brain is being activated.
